description: This file contains test cases for functions related to spawn context management, including normalization of spawn metadata, mapping tool context to spawn metadata, workspace inheritance resolution, and ingress workspace override handling. It uses Vitest testing framework and references functions implemented in 'spawned-context.js'.

methods.name: normalizeSpawnedRunMetadata
methods.description: Normalizes spawn metadata by trimming whitespace and dropping empty fields.

methods.name: mapToolContextToSpawnedRunMetadata
methods.description: Maps an agent group context to spawn run metadata shape.

methods.name: resolveSpawnedWorkspaceInheritance
methods.description: Resolves the workspace directory for a spawned agent, based on configuration and parameters.

methods.name: resolveIngressWorkspaceOverrideForSpawnedRun
methods.description: Determines if the workspace override should be forwarded for a spawned run.
